en: Mark 11

p.src: 2  and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

p.src: 4  They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

en: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

en: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

en: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

en:
11:9 “Hosanna” means “save us” or “help us, we pray”.
11:9 Psalms 118:25-26

p.src: 10  Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

p.src: 11  Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

en: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

en: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

p.src: 13  Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

en: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

p.src: 14  Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

en: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

p.src: 15  They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

en: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

p.src: 16  He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

en: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

p.src: 17  He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

p.src: 18  The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

en: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
u.src: 22  Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

p.src: 23  For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

en: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
u.src: 23  For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

p.src: 24  Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

en: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
u.src: 24  Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

p.src: 25  Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

en: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

en: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

en: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

en: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
